svg.title: dsh-lawcite-adapter: one citation inventory, eight rules, a field-column map
svg.desc: The header band and the seven rule-bearing fields of one citation row are laid out as columns. Each rule sits under the field or fields it reads, with the engine's own check kind: LC-001 presenceAny reads lawName and articleNo, LC-002 pattern reads articleNo, LC-003 presence and LC-008 containsAny read quotedText, LC-004 enum reads effectiveStatus, LC-005 presenceAny reads usage and purpose, LC-006 headerPresence reads the header, LC-007 unique reads citationNo. The real run of samples/quickstart/input/LC-001-unsafe.json yields one issue (LC-001, row 1, lawName: lawName and articleNo both empty) and one skipped rule (LC-004: values unset, enum cannot run). LC-002, LC-003, LC-005, LC-006, LC-007 and LC-008 ran and found nothing, so they enter neither list. The report band carries error 0, warn 0, info 1, issueCount 1, skippedCount 1, buildView, markdown plus reportJson, the wording guard and the disclaimer. The strip above the report keeps the boundary visible: statute existence, being in force, amendment or repeal, applicability, compliance and liability are not checked. The tool only reads file or material; the original is never modified and the verdict stays with the reviewer.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 8 rules read one citation inventory; every finding names a row and a field.
IN · file | material · JSON / YAML · header + rows[] · read-only
OUT · issues[] · skipped[] · summary · markdown + reportJson
